import pathlib,json,hashlib,io,importlib.metadata,numpy as np,soundfile as sf,sphn
from hindi_detector.wave_identity import comparison
root=pathlib.Path('/Volumes/T9/hindi-detector');out=root/'data/human_original_audio_pilot_v6';ins=json.loads((out/'inspection.json').read_text());old=json.loads((out/'waveform_correspondence.json').read_text())['records'];results=[]
for row,pair in zip(ins['records'],old,strict=True):
 original,sr=sf.read(out/row['payload_path'],dtype='float32',always_2d=True)
 # The actual inspected staging recipe: mean channels, sphn resample, peak .95, PCM16.
 decoded=sphn.resample(original.mean(axis=1),sr,24000)
 if decoded.ndim!=1: raise ValueError('Unexpected actual sphn result shape')
 predicted=decoded*(.95/(float(np.abs(decoded).max()) or 1.))
 buffer=io.BytesIO();sf.write(buffer,predicted,24000,format='WAV',subtype='PCM_16');encoded=buffer.getvalue()
 staged,br=sf.read(pair['staged_audio'],dtype='float32');results.append({'row':row['row'],'staged_audio':pair['staged_audio'],'original_payload_sha256':row['payload_sha256'],'reproduced_staged_sha256':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),'expected_staged_sha256':pair['staged_sha256'],'encoded_staged_bytes_identical':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()==pair['staged_sha256'],'waveform_comparison':comparison(predicted,24000,staged,br)})
package=pathlib.Path(sphn.__file__).parent
resources=[{'path':str(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(package.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.py','.so','.dylib','.pyi'}]
record={'source_utf8':SOURCE,'sphn_version':importlib.metadata.version('sphn'),'numpy_version':np.__version__,'soundfile_version':sf.__version__,'libsndfile_version':sf.__libsndfile_version__,'sphn_resources':resources,'results':results,'historical_preprocessing_revision_known':False,'conclusion':'Exact inspected-recipe reconstruction is checked per selected clip. Matching these two recordings does not establish all other staging clips or native-accent labels.'}
(out/'recipe_reproduction.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(results))
